name: Nosferatu Drei -Shirogane no Tsuki o Kurau Konjiki no Legion-
original_name: NosferatuDrei -白銀の月を喰らう金色の軍勢-
source:
"And so they surrender to the exotic seductions of the Nosferatu. 
The estrum lust, the siren, of vampiric grand guignol."

Play as a vampire who trains and enslaves young women while also warding off supernatural enemies. 

Your victims are devout nun Lily, descendent of witches Meg, and ancestral vampire princess Carmilla. 
Raise up these heroines as part of your household! Characters grow and develop in various ways! Fight boss monsters 
and clear each stage to unlock that character's sex scene. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081183.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“于是，她们屈服于吸血鬼异域而妖冶的诱惑。
发情的欲望、海妖的歌声，共同奏响吸血鬼恐怖剧。”

玩家扮演一名吸血鬼，在抵御超自然敌人的同时调教年轻女性，将她们化为奴隶。

你的猎物包括虔诚修女莉莉·奥尔科特、魔女后裔橘梅格，以及远祖吸血鬼公主卡米拉·诺伊恩多夫。
把这些女主角培养成自己的眷属吧！角色拥有多种成长方式！击败头目魔物并完成每个关卡，即可解锁对应角色的性爱场景。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081183.html]DLsite English[/url]]
